add.name: ADD
add.description: Sum the data point and correction value. E.g. y=x+ C, where x is the data point and C is the change factor.

lw_corr.name: LW_CORR
lw_corr.description: Correction for long wave radiation where calibration values are incorrect.

scalar.name: SCALAR
scalar.description: Multiply the data point by a correction factor. E.g. y=Cx where x is the data point and C is the correction factor.

pa_corr.name: PA_CORR
pa_corr.description: Correction for pressure where adjust has been calculated from mean sea level pressure.

power.name: POWER
power.description: Raise the data point to a power. E.g. y=x^C, x is the data point and C is the change factor.
